an4.234:1.1: Atha kho Sikho Moggallāno brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an4.234:1.2: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sikho Moggallāno brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.234:2.1: Purimāni bho Gotama divasāni purimatarāni Soṇakāyano māṇavo yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etad avoca :
an4.234:2.2: samaṇo Gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññāpeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññāpento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa
an4.234:3.1: Dassanam pi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa Soṇakāyassa māṇavassa nābhijānāmi,
an4.234:3.3: Cattār' imāni brāhmaṇa kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
an4.234:3.8: Atthi brāhmaṇa kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati. 3.
an4.234:4.1: Katamañ ca brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ?
an4.234:4.6: Idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. 4.
an4.234:5.1: Katamañ ca brāhmaṇa kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ?
an4.234:5.6: Idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. 5.
an4.234:6.1: Katamañ ca brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ?
an4.234:6.5: pe . . . seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
an4.234:6.6: Idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. 6.
an4.234:7.1: Katamañ ca brāhmaṇa kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati?
an4.234:7.2: Tatra brāhmaṇa yaṃ idaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā
an4.234:7.3: idaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.234:7.4: Imāni kho brāhmaṇa cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni. 234. 1. Cattār'
